verdict: The BMW Brunei International Half Marathon (BIHM) is genuinely notable simply for existing alongside The Brunei Half Marathon covered elsewhere in this research batch -- two distinct half marathons in a country rarely represented on regional race calendars, roughly two weeks apart. It's held in Berakas, an administrative and residential area within Bandar Seri Begawan, backed by luxury car brand BMW through AKIF Media Marketing & Event. Two distances (21.098K/10K) with genuinely wide source coverage (five distinct listings, including Instagram tracking) suggest real local visibility despite Brunei's smaller running-event footprint generally.

paragraphs: Berakas is an area within Bandar Seri Begawan encompassing several villages under the administrative subdivision Mukim Berakas 'A', including facilities like the Berakas Sports Complex and Berakas Secondary School.
